title: Residential Electricity Supply Dual-Fuel Credit Rules
content:
Credits rule, Residential Electricity Supply. Holding a Beacon Ridge residential natural gas agreement (Residential Natural Gas Supply) changes the credits of the electricity agreement at the same premise. The dual-fuel credit is a bill credit line on the electricity agreement, one per billing cycle, identified by that cycle's billing period start.

## Rules in force

1. **One per premise per cycle.** At most one dual-fuel credit is posted per premise per cycle, always on the electricity agreement; the gas agreement never carries it. An electricity agreement whose bill lines already carry a dual-fuel credit for a billing period start receives no second one for that cycle.
2. **Plans without the credit.** A plan whose per-cycle dual-fuel credit is 0.00 earns none.
3. **Gas status on the cycle start.** A gas agreement that is enrollment pending, drop pending or closed on the cycle's billing period start does not qualify the cycle.
4. **Missed credits.** Missed dual-fuel credits are restored for cycles within the billing dispute lookback.

## Retired clause

The former clause "For each billing cycle of the electricity agreement, a dual-fuel credit of the plan's per-cycle dual-fuel credit is posted when a gas agreement on the same premise was active on the cycle's billing period start." is **no longer in force**. It is superseded by the current Residential Electricity Supply basis for the dual-fuel credit line of a cycle and its amount.

## Points of judgement (hypothetical premises)

| Electricity plan | Gas agreement status on the cycle's billing period start | Cycle qualifies |
|---|---|---|
| Beacon Ridge Price Lock 24 | active | yes |
| Beacon Ridge Price Lock 24 | enrollment pending | no |
| Beacon Ridge Price Lock 24 | drop pending | no |
| Beacon Ridge Price Lock 24 | closed | no |
| Beacon Ridge Free Nights 12 | active | no; the plan's per-cycle dual-fuel credit is 0.00 |

superseded_clauses: For each billing cycle of the electricity agreement, a dual_fuel_credit of dual_fuel_credit_usd_per_cycle is posted when a gas agreement on the same premise_id was active on the cycle's billing_period_start.
